title: Domain modeling
summary: Builds and sharpens a project's domain model via glossary terms and architecture decision records.
details: This skill makes Claude build and sharpen your project's domain model as you work: it challenges terms that conflict with GLOSSARY.md, proposes precise names, invents edge-case scenarios, checks claims against the code, and writes glossary terms and ADRs as decisions settle. It is for teams discussing codebase terminology or recording decisions. It adds a skill folder that loads only when used; instructions only, so no code runs on its own.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
